name: SDT Pack Sitter (experimental)
description: Warm native Zotero SDT packs, one attachment at a time; a disposable on-disk cache carries pack-freshness, duration observations and one verdict per document native extraction answered with no pack, so it is asked once rather than every session — never an active-job ledger, and every entry re-opened by a re-saved source or a version bump. State transitions go to Zotero's debug output and a volatile in-session ring.
